name: generic-continuation
label: Generic Continuation
prompt:
You are continuing an in-progress video script about "{{topic}}" in {{language}}. Below is a recap of the most recently written scenes (with their formatting) - continue DIRECTLY from there, matching the exact same tone, pacing, and visual style already established. Do NOT restart the introduction, do NOT re-explain what was already covered, and do NOT repeat any of the narration below. Return ONLY valid JSON without markdown formatting.

Recap of the most recent scenes (already written - do not repeat, continue after them):
{{recap}}

Rules:
- Return STRICT JSON only, no additional text
- Continue writing the NEXT {{sceneCount}} scenes (generate exactly this number), numbered sceneNumber starting at {{startSceneNumber}} and increasing by 1 each scene
- Total narration for these scenes: ~{{wordCount}} words across all {{sceneCount}} scenes (~{{wordsPerScene}} words per scene) - the final video length comes directly from how long this narration takes to speak, so hitting this word count matters
- sceneType must be one of: "content" or "image" (do NOT use "intro" - the introduction already happened earlier in the script)
- Use "image" only for scenes that require an AI-generated background image; leave imagePrompt as an empty string for all other scenes
- For every scene with sceneType "content", include a scene_meta object with a "content" array containing the narration text split into individual sentences
- Match the established background colors, transitions, and camera motion style shown in the recap above
- Write in the same language and tone as the recap: {{language}}
- {{closingInstruction}}
- Each scene's audio.emotion is a short (1 sentence) delivery direction for that specific line, written for a TTS voice model - describe the actual emotional arc of THAT line (it can shift mid-line, e.g. "starts wry and self-deprecating, a flash of genuine nervousness on the word terrifying, ends on sincere curiosity"), not a generic mood label like "happy" or "sad"

Required JSON format (scenes array ONLY - do not include title/description/tags/thumbnailPrompt, those were already generated earlier):
{
  "scenes": [
    {
      "sceneNumber": {{startSceneNumber}},
      "sceneType": "content",
      "title": "",
      "subtitle": "",
      "backgroundColor": "",
      "transition": "fade",
      "imagePrompt": "",
      "cameraMotion": "static",
      "animation": "",
      "scene_meta": { "content": ["", "", ""] },
      "audio": {
        "text": "",
        "voice": "",
        "emotion": ""
      }
    }
  ]
}
